domain_aggregation.note: domain_severity = max(mean_signal_severity, max_signal_severity - escalation_offset). Ordinary watch-level noise stays near the mean; a single orange/red signal pulls the domain toward its own severity so acute events are not averaged away.

trip_wires.note: A single confirmed catastrophic signal should floor the whole index regardless of the weighted arithmetic. When a listed signal's final severity reaches min_severity, the total score is raised to at least floor_score (highest applicable floor wins).

cumulative.note: Cumulative Erosion Sub-Index (CEI) parameters — see docs/cumulative-erosion-subindex-proposal.md. pressure = per-signal EWMA of daily final_score with the given half-life; ledger entries (data/erosion_ledger.json) are human-vetted structural conditions. CEI = min(100, ledger_score + pressure_coefficient * pressure_score). CEI is provisional until the ledger is seeded.

ai.note: Optional LLM extraction layer. When ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set and the anthropic SDK is installed, each candidate article is read by the model and returned as a structured judgment (US-domestic? actually occurred vs hypothetical/denied/historical? which signal? severity 0-4? primary source? one-line rationale?). Severity is derived from confirmed events instead of raw keyword volume. If the SDK or key is unavailable the run falls back to the deterministic keyword scorer and marks confidence accordingly. Haiku is used because this is a high-volume, short-input classification task run many times per day; change 'model' to raise capability at higher cost.
ai.system_prompt: You are a neutral analyst for a U.S. constitutional-risk early-warning dashboard. You read a single news item and decide, strictly and conservatively, whether it is EVIDENCE that a specific constitutional-stress event actually occurred in the United States. Distinguish real occurrences from hypotheticals, denials, opinion, satire, historical retrospectives, and coverage of other countries. When in doubt, treat the item as weak or irrelevant evidence. Do not inflate severity from emotional or high-volume coverage; severity reflects what verifiably happened, not how loudly it is reported.

primary_sources.note: Primary-source evidence ingestion. Official records are fetched per signal from the Federal Register API (executive orders, presidential memoranda and proclamations, agency rules and notices) and the CourtListener API (federal docket entries via RECAP, and published opinions), then merged into the same evidence list as news items and judged by the same AI extraction layer. Primary documents carry source_tier='primary' and can anchor a red-level (4) severity on their own, where news items still require two independent publishers. Both APIs are free and work without a key; COURTLISTENER_API_TOKEN is optional and only raises the rate limit. Only signals that declare a primary_sources block are queried.

federal_register.note: Document type codes: PRESDOCU (presidential documents), RULE, PRORULE, NOTICE. conditions[term] is an AND over every word with no boolean OR, so each entry in a signal's 'terms' list is issued as its own request and the results are merged.

courtlistener.note: search_type 'r' searches RECAP federal dockets; 'o' searches published opinions. CourtListener's documented limits for authenticated callers are 5 requests/minute, 50/hour and 125/day, so requests are spaced ~13s to stay under the per-minute rate; 10 signals use ~10 of the 125 daily calls. A 429 is retried with backoff. COURTLISTENER_API_TOKEN is optional -- anonymous access works but throttles harder.

link_resolution.note: Google News RSS gives redirect links of 260-340 characters. They are resolved to publisher URLs once here so every consumer gets a short, real citation - the rendered site shows the outlet's own domain rather than news.google.com, and consumers that must fit a citation inside a length budget (the Bluesky commentary drafter gets 300 graphemes per post) have room to write. The endpoint is undocumented; failure degrades to the original Google link and never fails the run.
